documents.subject: Summer safety reminder - dust suppression
documents.body: With the dry weather, water trucks must run on haul roads every two hours at all pits. Supervisors should log each pass in the daily site report. PPE audits resume next week.

documents.body:
Dear Sirs:

Please schedule bulk diesel deliveries to our yard every Tuesday and Friday through October 31. Quantities will be confirmed by our yard foreman the day before each delivery.

JMB Crushing Systems Inc.
